decks.notes: The main focus of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to quickly swarm the board with aggressive creatures like Cabal Archon, Priest of Gix, and Rotlung Reanimator, while disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Duress and Cabal Therapy. The deck also includes removal spells like Snuff Out and Smother to deal with problematic threats. The mana base is optimized with Rishadan Port and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and control the game through hand disruption and removal spells.

The focus of this deck is to utilize the Stiflenought combo, which involves playing Phyrexian Dreadnought and then countering its triggered ability with Stifle or other spells to create a powerful 12/12 creature for just one mana. The deck includes various card draw and control spells to help find the combo pieces and protect the strategy. By effectively stifling Dreadnought's drawback, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a big threat early in the game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through countering opponent's spells, removing threats with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares, and stalling the game with cards like Parallax Tide and Seal of Cleansing. The deck aims to draw into more cards with Accumulated Knowledge and Fact or Fiction while efficiently managing mana with cards like Mana Leak and Impulse. The win condition often comes from resolving Decree of Justice or Wrath of God to clear the board and secure a victory. The deck also includes utility lands like Dust Bowl for additional control.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent's resources and disrupt their gameplay while utilizing Oath of Druids to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Terravore. With efficient land destruction and counterspells, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's strategy and take control of the game. The deck also includes cards like Sylvan Library to help with card advantage and consistency. Overall, the deck is designed to manipulate the game in your favor and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to generate a ton of card advantage by playing multiple enchantments, especially with Argothian Enchantress and Enchantress's Presence. By using cards like Sterling Grove and Mirri's Guile to search for key pieces, this deck aims to create a strong board state quickly. The combo potential comes from cards like Replenish and Opalescence, which can help overwhelm the opponent with a massive board of enchanted creatures. The inclusion of control elements like Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing also provides some interaction with the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through counterspells and removal spells while building up resources and card advantage. By controlling the battlefield with cards like Counterspell and Swords to Plowshares, the deck aims to gradually out-value the opponent with draw spells like Opt and Accumulated Knowledge. The deck also looks to generate mana advantage with cards like Mox Diamond and Gush, in order to cast powerful threats such as Psychatog and Quirion Dryad. Overall, the deck aims to maintain control of the game while steadily growing its own resources and threats.

The deck focuses on playing low-cost aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent, aiming to end the game as quickly as possible before the opponent can set up their own strategy. With a focus on efficient spells and creatures, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to recover. The mana base is streamlined to support the low curve of the deck and ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with low-cost, high damage creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Ball Lightning, Grim Lavamancer, and Jackal Pup, along with efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast, the goal is to deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible. The inclusion of cards like Cursed Scroll and Sulfuric Vortex further accelerates this strategy, forcing the opponent to constantly deal with threats and pressure. The deck prioritizes aggression and speed to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence of Elves and utilizing cards like Gaea's Cradle and Priest of Titania to generate a lot of mana. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a large number of creatures and powerful spells, such as Armageddon to disrupt their resources. The inclusion of Concordant Crossroads allows for hasty attacks and aggressive plays, while Survival of the Fittest ensures that necessary cards can be found efficiently. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficient mana production and aggressive creature deployment to secure victory.

This deck is focused on quickly ramping up mana with elves to cast powerful creatures such as Multani's Acolyte and Verdant Force. The deck also utilizes cards like Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger to generate additional mana and keep the pressure on the opponent. Natural Order allows for more consistent access to key creatures like Deranged Hermit, while Survival of the Fittest helps to search for essential pieces of the deck. The inclusion of cards like Tangle Wire and Anger can help control the board and ensure the opponent struggles to keep up with the aggressive elf strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up mana through cards like Wild Growth and Exploration, while drawing cards and gaining advantages through enchantresses like Argothian Enchantress and Enchantress's Presence. The deck includes key combo pieces like Replenish and Opalescence to create a win condition. It also includes protection and lockdown cards like Elephant Grass and Seal of Cleansing to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to establish a strong enchantment presence on the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent with its enchantress synergy and combo potential.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling a powerful combo using cards like Lion's Eye Diamond, Cabal Ritual, and Ill-Gotten Gains to generate mana and dig through the deck for key pieces. Cunning Wish and Intuition offer flexibility in finding needed cards, while Brain Freeze serves as the finisher in milling out the opponent. The deck aims to win the game in the early turns through efficient use of resources and careful planning.

The core idea of this deck revolves around countering and controlling opponent's plays while maintaining card advantage and board control. It focuses on using counterspells like Mana Leak and Counterspell to disrupt opponents, while also having utility cards like Stifle and Chain of Vapor. Parallax Tide and Powder Keg provide additional control elements, while the land base consists of utility lands like Dust Bowl and Quicksand, along with creature lands like Faerie Conclave and Mishra's Factory. The deck aims to outlast opponents through control and resource management.

The main focus of this deck is to consistently set up the combo of Replenish, Opalescence, and either Parallax Wave or Parallax Tide to overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing cards like Attunement and Intuition to tutor for combo pieces and disruption spells like Mana Leak and Swords to Plowshares to control the board, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo and win the game in a swift and efficient manner. The inclusion of cards like Frantic Search and Stifle help to further support the deck's strategy of comboing off and overpowering the opponent.

The main strategy of this RG Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck focuses on dealing damage early and efficiently, with cards like Grim Lavamancer, Jackal Pup, and Lightning Bolt. It also includes disruption with cards like Naturalize and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's game plan. This deck aims to put pressure on the opponent from the beginning of the game, with a mix of creatures, burn spells, and land destruction to control the battlefield and secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on aggressive play with creatures like Terravore and Meddling Mage, backed up by support cards like Swords to Plowshares and Mox Diamond. It also utilizes land destruction with cards like Armageddon and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Sylvan Library helps with card draw and selection, while cards like Call of the Herd provide additional threats. The mana base is crafted to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana for the spells in the deck.
